title: Placement: Container With Most Water
description: You are given an integer array `height` of length `n`. There are `n` vertical lines drawn such that the two endpoints of the `i`th line are `(i, 0)` and `(i, height[i])`. Find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container that stores the most water. Return the maximum volume.
explanation: Two pointers from the outside move the shorter wall inward, maximizing the width-height tradeoff in O(N) time.
